# OZBO

> Industrial ceramic materials supplier specializing in advanced ceramics including silicon nitride, silicon carbide, aluminum nitride, alumina, and specialized thermal/refractory products.

OZBO is a leading supplier of high-performance industrial ceramics and nano-materials, offering both standard product catalogs and OEM/ODM manufacturing services. The company serves industries requiring wear-resistant, thermal management, and refractory solutions.

## Key Topics

- Silicon Carbide (SiC)
- Silicon Nitride (Si3N4)
- Aluminum Nitride (AlN)
- Alumina (Al2O3)
- Boron Nitride (BN)
- Boron Carbide (B4C)
- Zirconia (ZrO2)
- High-temperature materials
- Thermal insulation
- Wear-resistant ceramics
- Refractory materials
- Ceramic components
- Advanced ceramics
- OEM/ODM manufacturing
- Industrial applications

- [Alumina Al2O3 Ceramic](https://www.ozbo.com/products/alumina-ceramic): Alumina Al2O3 ceramic product page featuring wear-resistant liners and components
- [Boron Nitride BN](https://www.ozbo.com/products/boron-nitride-bn): Boron Nitride BN product page with thermal and high-performance applications
- [Boron Carbide B4C](https://www.ozbo.com/products/boron-carbide-bc4): Boron Carbide B4C product page for sandblasting nozzles and wear-resistant uses
- [Zirconia Ceramic](https://www.ozbo.com/products/zirconia-ceramic): Zirconia ZrO2 ceramic product page with refractory and dental applications

## Specialized Products

- [Ceramic Crucible](https://www.ozbo.com/products/ceramic-crucible): Ceramic crucible product page for high-temperature metal melting applications
- [Refractory Material](https://www.ozbo.com/products/refractory-material): Refractory materials product page for furnace and kiln applications
- [Ceramic Fiber](https://www.ozbo.com/products/ceramic-fiber): Ceramic fiber and blanket products for high-temperature insulation
- [Aerogel Thermal](https://www.ozbo.com/products/aerogel-thermal): Silica aerogel thermal insulation products for pipelines and high-temp uses
- [Quartz Ceramic](https://www.ozbo.com/products/quartz-product): Quartz and fused silica product page for laboratory and heat-resistant uses
